scope: Read-only local inventory and bounded SQL type probes. DuckDB queries used in-memory databases.
actions_not_taken: No PostgreSQL server or database initialization
No native builds or test suites
No edits to maintained source or earlier W05 evidence

source_evidence.relevance: W05 requires SQL-oracle comparison with matching casts, collation and types; plain bags, general NULL/type behavior, DISTINCT/grouping behavior, and set-fixture preservation.
Active handoff starts W05 with general SQL NULL/type behavior, plain SELECT bags, explicit source admission, and separate aggregate grouping NULL rules.
CROWN Decimal has a maximum 38-digit coefficient and scale 0..38; it is not SQL DECIMAL(p,s) coercion.
Decimal parsing/canonicalization implementation for the bounded value domain.

python_probes.name: mixed_decimal_extremes_union
python_probes.interpretation: The second exact input, 1E-38, was coerced to zero by UNION type resolution.

python_probes.name: precision_39_rejected
python_probes.sql: SELECT CAST('1' AS DECIMAL(39,0)) AS v
python_probes.error: Binder Error: DECIMAL type width must be between 1 and 38

python_probes.name: 38_digit_unqualified_numeric_rejected
python_probes.error: Conversion to DECIMAL(18,3) failed for the 38-digit integer.

cli_probes.name: default_numeric_date_boolean_types
cli_probes.sql: SELECT typeof(CAST('1' AS NUMERIC)), typeof(CAST('1.23' AS NUMERIC)), typeof(DATE '2024-02-29'), typeof(TRUE)

limitations: Unqualified NUMERIC is DECIMAL(18,3) in these versions, not an unconstrained arbitrary-scale decimal.
The tested UNION ALL silently loses the 1E-38 operand when combined with DECIMAL(38,0).
DATE and BOOLEAN evidence covers basic literals only; broader casts/ranges were not audited.
Collation behavior was not probed; W05 comparisons must match CROWN's declared binary collation.
duckdb.assessment: DuckDB is usable for explicitly fixed DECIMAL(p,s), DATE and BOOLEAN cases when SQL types and casts are matched. It is not a safe direct oracle for the full CROWN Decimal value domain across varying scales.
